n.quote: The final sample comprised 42 younger (21 females, age range = 18–30, M = 24.00, s.d. = 3.20) and 44 older (22 females, age range = 65–77, M = 69.50, s.d. = 3.74) individuals. one participant (YA = 1) from the analysis of compassion due to them being extreme outliers (greater than 3 s.d.)
n.sample_role: participants in the target test; younger and older adult groups
n.exclusions: 15 of 101 excluded: inability to undergo scanning (5), hearing/sight problems (4), termination/technical problems (2), neurological abnormalities (4). Two below-chance participants retained. Button-box and sleep trials excluded and scores proportionally adjusted. Compassion additionally excludes one younger extreme outlier (>3 s.d.); analytic 85 established from final 86 minus 1.
